dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほらほら兄さん、しゃきっとしなさい」
dialogues.en: "Come on, niisan. Shape up!"
dialogues.text: "Come on, niisan. Shape up!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うぉ」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh!"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh!"

dialogues.jp:
腰に手を当てられて、無理やり背筋を伸ばされ
る。
dialogues.en:
She straightens me up forcefully, putting her hands on my
waist.
dialogues.text:
She straightens me up forcefully, putting her hands on my
waist.

dialogues.jp:
「う〜、どうしてさくらの家に泊まるのに、朝
　起こされなきゃならんのだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Ow... Why do I have to get up early in the morning when I'm
going to sleep over at Sakura's house?"
dialogues.text:
"Ow... Why do I have to get up early in the morning when I'm
going to sleep over at Sakura's house?"

dialogues.jp: 首をぐるぐると回しつつ呟くというか、うめく。
dialogues.en: I mutter, or rather I groan, dragging my head around.
dialogues.text: I mutter, or rather I groan, dragging my head around.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうせ家を空けるんですから、一緒に出ちゃっ
　たほうがいいじゃないですか」
dialogues.en:
"We'll be going sooner or later, so let's leave the house at
the same time."
dialogues.text:
"We'll be going sooner or later, so let's leave the house at
the same time."

dialogues.jp:
委員会の用事がつまっている音夢が、玄関に鍵
をかけて指を振る。
dialogues.en:
As Nemu shakes her finger and locks the front door, I
remember she's busy with committee work.
dialogues.text:
As Nemu shakes her finger and locks the front door, I
remember she's busy with committee work.

dialogues.jp:
いつもなら苦笑いを浮かべていそうだが、今日
に限っては表情が固い。
dialogues.en:
She usually gives a wry smile, but somehow her face is stern
today.
dialogues.text:
She usually gives a wry smile, but somehow her face is stern
today.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「で、何日ほどお泊まりの予定ですか？」
dialogues.en: "So, how long do you think you're going to stay over there?"
dialogues.text: "So, how long do you think you're going to stay over there?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「１週間くらいですか？」
dialogues.en: "About a week?"
dialogues.text: "About a week?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと待て……どうしてさくらの家に７日
　も泊まらなきゃいけないんだ俺は？」
dialogues.en:
"Hold on... Why do I have to stay at Sakura's house for
seven days?"
dialogues.text:
"Hold on... Why do I have to stay at Sakura's house for
seven days?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あら、二人とも仲が良いご様子でしたので、
　積もる話もあるでしょ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, you guys looked very close, so I thought you must have
a lot of catching up to do."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, you guys looked very close, so I thought you must have
a lot of catching up to do."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「６年間の話を、１日１年ずつ語られてきてく
　ださればいいですから♪」
dialogues.en:
"You can talk about one year's worth stuff per day, so 6
years will take 6 days."
dialogues.text:
"You can talk about one year's worth stuff per day, so 6
years will take 6 days."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あの、音夢様……」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me, Nemu-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, Nemu-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしました兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "What is it, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "What is it, niisan?"

dialogues.jp: 底意地が悪いとしか思えない笑み。
dialogues.en: She gives a malicious grin.
dialogues.text: She gives a malicious grin.

dialogues.jp: 「正直に機嫌直してくれ」
dialogues.en: "Please don't do that to me!"
dialogues.text: "Please don't do that to me!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのなぁ、俺とさくらは別になんでもないん
　だぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, you know, there is nothing going on between Sakura and
me."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, you know, there is nothing going on between Sakura and
me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにもない人がキスなんてしますか？」
dialogues.en:
"If nothing's going on between you guys, how can you kiss
her?"
dialogues.text:
"If nothing's going on between you guys, how can you kiss
her?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや……あれは、そういうことじゃなくて」
dialogues.en: "No, that wasn't what you think."
dialogues.text: "No, that wasn't what you think."

dialogues.jp:
パントマイムでおひねりをもらえそうなほど、
手が複雑な動きをする。
dialogues.en: I wave my hands dramatically like in a pantomime.
dialogues.text: I wave my hands dramatically like in a pantomime.

dialogues.jp:
「ん……なんで俺は、浮気が奥さんにばれたみ
　たいな反応せにゃならんのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah... Why do I have to feel as if I got caught in a love
affair?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah... Why do I have to feel as if I got caught in a love
affair?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、俺とさくらがキスをしていたのを、
　どうしてお前に怒られなきゃいけないんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you get angry at our kiss?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you get angry at our kiss?"

dialogues.jp: 素で反応していた俺も俺だが。
dialogues.en:
Well, I have to admit that I did act without thinking,
but...
dialogues.text:
Well, I have to admit that I did act without thinking,
but...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だ、だって、あんな｛はれんち／破廉恥｝なこと……」
dialogues.en: "Because it was an indecent act."
dialogues.text: "Because it was an indecent act."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「キスが破廉恥？　恋人がいるならともかく、
　別に破廉恥ってことはないだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Is kissing indecent to you? If I had a girlfriend, then you
could say kissing someone else was an indecent act."
dialogues.text:
"Is kissing indecent to you? If I had a girlfriend, then you
could say kissing someone else was an indecent act."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う……うん、そうなんだけど……あれ？」
dialogues.en: "Um... yeah, that's right. Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Um... yeah, that's right. Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: ふたりして腕組みしてしまう。
dialogues.en: Both of us are standing with our arms folded.
dialogues.text: Both of us are standing with our arms folded.

dialogues.jp: 「……なにか前提条件が間違ってないか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you think your assumption is wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you think your assumption is wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
そう。ふたりとも兄妹ではなく恋人ならば、今
までの会話が成り立つのだ。
dialogues.en:
Right. If we were a couple, not sister and brother, then
what we were saying makes sense.
dialogues.text:
Right. If we were a couple, not sister and brother, then
what we were saying makes sense.

dialogues.jp:
困ったようなはにかんだ笑みを浮かべて、音夢
が頷く。
dialogues.en: Nemu nods, giving an embarrassed smile.
dialogues.text: Nemu nods, giving an embarrassed smile.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは、ちょっと大人気なかったね」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... I guess I acted very immature this time."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... I guess I acted very immature this time."

dialogues.jp: 元からガキだけどな――とは口にしない。
dialogues.en:
You're immature from the beginning, but I would never say
it.
dialogues.text:
You're immature from the beginning, but I would never say
it.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、お泊りなんて今日１日だけだ。それよ
　り、早くしないと遅刻するぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'll sleep over for only one day, that's it. Hey,
you'll be late if you don't go now."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'll sleep over for only one day, that's it. Hey,
you'll be late if you don't go now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁい」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I know."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I know."

dialogues.jp: とことこ、と歩いて、急に音夢が振り返る。
dialogues.en: While walking away, Nemu suddenly turns back toward me.
dialogues.text: While walking away, Nemu suddenly turns back toward me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、校門まで一緒に行かない？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to walk with me up to the school gate?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to walk with me up to the school gate?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは」
dialogues.en: "Ahahahaha."
dialogues.text: "Ahahahaha."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、なんで笑うんですかぁ！？」
dialogues.en: "What's so funny?"
dialogues.text: "What's so funny?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや」
dialogues.en: "Nothing."
dialogues.text: "Nothing."

dialogues.jp: ひとしきり笑いながら、俺は妹の隣に並ぶ。
dialogues.en: I walk beside my sister laughing for some time.
dialogues.text: I walk beside my sister laughing for some time.

dialogues.jp:
なるほど、この甘えん坊な性格なら、音夢がキ
スを快く思わないのも分かる。
dialogues.en:
I understand why Nemu wasn't happy about our kiss, knowing
her overly reliant character.
dialogues.text:
I understand why Nemu wasn't happy about our kiss, knowing
her overly reliant character.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、暇つぶしには丁度いい」
dialogues.en: "It's perfect for killing time."
dialogues.text: "It's perfect for killing time."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ……もぅ」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お姫様の送り迎えくらいさせてもらうさ」
dialogues.en: "I can take care of Your Highness to and from school."
dialogues.text: "I can take care of Your Highness to and from school."

dialogues.jp: すねる妹の頭に手を置いて、俺は小さく笑った。
dialogues.en:
As my sister starts to sulk, I laugh a little and pat her on
the head.
dialogues.text:
As my sister starts to sulk, I laugh a little and pat her on
the head.

dialogues.jp: ◆前提条件◆
dialogues.en: ◆Prerequisite◆
dialogues.text: ◆Prerequisite◆

dialogues.jp:
翌日、学園で委員会の仕事のある音夢と同じ時
間に起こされてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Next day, Nemu had some work to do for the committee, and
woke me up at the same time she got up.
dialogues.text:
Next day, Nemu had some work to do for the committee, and
woke me up at the same time she got up.

dialogues.jp:
さくらと俺のキスを目撃して不機嫌な音夢だっ
たが、なんとか誤解をとき、笑顔で校門まで送
ることになった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was not in a good mood after she saw me and Sakura
kiss. However, we finally cleared up the misunderstanding,
and I escorted her to the school gate with a smile.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was not in a good mood after she saw me and Sakura
kiss. However, we finally cleared up the misunderstanding,
and I escorted her to the school gate with a smile.
